parameters.name: TrialType
parameters.description:
The trial type of the service instance. Valid values:

*   **Trial**: Trials are supported.
*   **NotTrial**: Trials are not supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest check-service-deployable --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx --trial-type NotTrial --pre-paid-amount 0.0 --post-paid-amount 1.29 --template-name Template_1 --service-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenest CheckServiceDeployable --region cn-hangzhou --PrePaidAmount '0.0' --TrialType NotTrial --TemplateName Template_1 --ServiceVersion 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PostPaidAmount '1.29' --ServiceId 'service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx'
